title: Show check
audioDeviceMissing: The selected audio output was not found. Check your devices in the settings.
batteryLowNoEstimate: Battery at {{percent}}%, and the system gives no estimate of the remaining runtime. Plug the computer into mains power.
batteryShorterThanShow: Battery runtime {{left}}, shorter than the show ({{total}}). Plug the computer into mains power.
batteryShorterThanShowAtLeast: Battery runtime {{left}}, shorter than the show (at least {{total}}). Plug the computer into mains power.
batteryShorterThanAct: Battery runtime {{left}}, shorter than the act ({{total}}). Plug the computer into mains power.
batteryShorterThanActAtLeast: Battery runtime {{left}}, shorter than the act (at least {{total}}). Plug the computer into mains power.
trackFadesTooLong: Fade in + fade out longer than the playback span on {{label}}
outputRoutingUnsupported: Choosing the audio output is not supported on this system: sound will go to the default output.
trackStartBeyondFile: Start past the end of the file on {{label}}: nothing will play
trackEndBeyondFile: End past the end of the file on {{label}}: the track will play to its end
